# This workflow will do a clean install of node dependencies, build the source code and run tests across different versions of node
# For more information see: https://help.github.com/actions/language-and-framework-guides/using-nodejs-with-github-actions

name: Node.js CI
permissions:
  contents: read

on:
  push:
    branches: [ master, '[0-9]+.[0-9]+.x' ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ master, '[0-9]+.[0-9]+.x' ]

jobs:
  # Lint, builds and the Node-only tests. The browser suites run in the coverage job below, in parallel.
  build-lint:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
      - name: Use Node.js 24
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7.1.0
        with:
            node-version: 24.x
            cache: 'npm'
      - name: Install packages
        run: npm ci
      - name: Lint Lib
        run: npm run lint:lib
        env:
            NODE_OPTIONS: --max_old_space_size=4096
      - name: Lint i18n
        run: npm run lint:i18n
      - name: Lint Extras
        run: npm run lint:extras
      - name: Build Lib
        run: npm run build:lib
      - name: Build Extras
        run: npm run build:extras
      - name: Build Schematics
        run: npm run build:schematics
      - name: Build Migrations
        run: npm run build:migrations
      - name: Build TypeDoc & SassDoc
        run: |
            npm run build:docs
      - name: Build Elements
        run: npm run elements:configure && npm run build:elements
      - name: Check for Elements config changes
        run: |
            if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain -- projects/igniteui-angular-elements/**/elements.config.ts)" ]; then
                echo "Error: There are changes to the Elements config. Run 'npm run elements:configure' and commit." >&2
                exit 1
            fi
      - name: Build i18n & validate output
        run: |
            npm run build:i18n
            npm run test:i18n:dist
      - name: Test Styles, Schematics, i18n and SSR
        run: |
            npm run test:styles
            npm run test:schematics
            npm run test:i18n
            npm run test:ssr
        env:
            NODE_OPTIONS: --max_old_space_size=4096 --no-experimental-strip-types
            TZ: America/New_York
      - name: Bundle Tree-Shake & SSR Test
        run: npm run build:bundletest

  # Browser suites, run once with coverage. They build the specs from source,
  # so they don't wait for the builds above.
  test-coverage:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
      - name: Use Node.js 24
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7.1.0
        with:
            node-version: 24.x
            cache: 'npm'
      - name: Install packages
        run: npm ci
      - name: Get Playwright version
        id: playwright
        run: echo "version=$(node -p "require('playwright-core/package.json').version")" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Cache Playwright browsers
        id: playwright-cache
        uses: actions/cache@v6.1.0
        with:
            path: ~/.cache/ms-playwright
            key: playwright-${{ runner.os }}-${{ steps.playwright.outputs.version }}
      - name: Install Playwright Browsers
        if: steps.playwright-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Install Playwright system dependencies
        if: steps.playwright-cache.outputs.cache-hit == 'true'
        ru

      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check

          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
